trigger.observation: At the northbound turn, full detector boxes from Cameras D and E were refused because the hull gate evaluated only the drifted point-estimate yaw. The same box satisfied the unchanged gate at yaw values inside the belief's own 95% marginal interval.
trigger.method_failure: Treating an uncertain nuisance orientation as exactly known created a feedback lockout: heading drift caused correct boxes to be refused, which prevented the position correction that could reduce the drifted belief.
trigger.selection_use: V11 is a non-inferential engineering preflight and may trigger this adapter amendment; it is not an experimental replicate or a result.

data_boundary.authorized_population: All 9,600 Stage-06 commissioning_fit camera opportunities, including detector misses and non-positive semantic references.
data_boundary.independence_statement: The Stage-09 final audit was opened before this runtime-adapter failure was found. It is therefore not independent validation for the amended adapter and must not be used for threshold or method selection.
data_boundary.audit_role: Commissioning-only deterministic robustness diagnostic; perturbation draws are not independent replicates.

adapter.name: covariance-supported nuisance-yaw hull admission
adapter.fallback_trigger: Evaluate yaw hypotheses only when the point-estimate yaw fails the locked Stage-06 hull gate.
adapter.sample_rule: Uniform deterministic odd grid including the mean and both endpoints of the marginal yaw interval.
adapter.candidate_rule: A candidate must pass every unchanged Stage-06 hull criterion.
adapter.selection_rule: Among passing candidates minimize squared log width-ratio plus squared log height-ratio; break ties by the smallest absolute yaw displacement.
adapter.position_rule: Do not search x or y. Retain the timestamp-matched belief x/y.
adapter.measurement_rule: Use the selected nuisance yaw only for the analytic equivalent-position observation and the already-frozen Stage-07 features.
adapter.heading_update: Position only; the camera never updates or publishes robot heading.

comparators: point_yaw: locked Stage-06 gate and Stage-07 model evaluated at the perturbed point-estimate pose
nuisance_yaw: identical pipeline with the declared covariance-supported fallback
reporting: All opportunity, reference, admission, refusal and recovery counts.
Precision, reference-positive recall and added false admissions by regime, camera and spatial block.
Stage-07 corrected median, RMS, p90, p95, maximum and count above 0.25 m on admitted readings.
R2C-only and operational Pxy+R2C ellipse containment and squared-Mahalanobis tail counts.
An immutable per-opportunity ledger sufficient to reconstruct every summary.
prohibitions: Do not change the detector confidence or Stage-06 hull thresholds from this audit.
Do not fit or refit the Stage-07 correction or covariance model.
Do not use the final-audit population to select this adapter or its constants.
Do not call deterministic perturbations independent samples or campaign replicates.
Do not launch the final navigation campaign unless this audit and a fresh end-to-end preflight both pass.
